entries.title: Hosea 8:1
segments: ¶[Set] the trumpet to thy mouth. [He shall come] as an eagle against the house of the LORD, because they have transgressed my covenant, and trespassed against my law. {thy: Heb. the roof of thy}

entries.title: Hosea 8:2
segments: Israel shall cry unto me, My God, we know thee.

entries.title: Hosea 8:3
segments: Israel hath cast off [the thing that is] good: the enemy shall pursue him.

entries.title: Hosea 8:4
segments: They have set up kings, but not by me: they have made princes, and I knew [it] not: of their silver and their gold have they made them idols, that they may be cut off.

words.text: , but not by me: they have made princes
, that they may be cut off

entries.title: Hosea 8:5
segments: Thy calf, O Samaria, hath cast [thee] off; mine anger is kindled against them: how long [will it be] ere they attain to innocency?

words.text: against them: how long [will it be] ere

entries.title: Hosea 8:6
segments: For from Israel [was] it also: the workman made it; therefore it [is] not God: but the calf of Samaria shall be broken in pieces.

entries.title: Hosea 8:7
segments: For they have sown the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind: it hath no stalk: the bud shall yield no meal: if so be it yield, the strangers shall swallow it up. {stalk: or, standing corn}

entries.title: Hosea 8:8
segments: ¶Israel is swallowed up: now shall they be among the Gentiles as a vessel wherein [is] no pleasure.

words.text: : now shall they be among the Gentiles

entries.title: Hosea 8:9
segments: For they are gone up to Assyria, a wild ass alone by himself: Ephraim hath hired lovers. {lovers: Heb. loves}

entries.title: Hosea 8:10
segments: Yea, though they have hired among the nations, now will I gather them, and they shall sorrow a little for the burden of the king of princes. {sorrow: or, begin} {a...: or, in a little while}

words.text: . {sorrow: or, begin} {a...: or, in a little while}

entries.title: Hosea 8:11
segments: Because Ephraim hath made many altars to sin, altars shall be unto him to sin.

words.text: shall be unto him to sin

entries.title: Hosea 8:12
segments: I have written to him the great things of my law, [but] they were counted as a strange thing.

entries.title: Hosea 8:13
segments: They sacrifice flesh [for] the sacrifices of mine offerings, and eat [it; but] the LORD accepteth them not; now will he remember their iniquity, and visit their sins: they shall return to Egypt. {They sacrifice...: or, In the sacrifices of mine offerings they, etc}

words.text: them not; now will he remember
. {They sacrifice...: or, In the sacrifices of mine offerings they, etc}

entries.title: Hosea 8:14
segments: For Israel hath forgotten his Maker, and buildeth temples; and Judah hath multiplied fenced cities: but I will send a fire upon his cities, and it shall devour the palaces thereof.
